args.summary:
Model built successfully for a 10-span (10×25 m) precast small-box girder continuous bridge (continuous after erection, no construction-stage system conversion), modelled as a 2D spine beam (structure.idealization=spine_beam_2d, structure.system=continuous).

Structure/material: 4 precast prestressed small-box girders per span, C50. Middle-girder section integrated from the given geometry (h=1.4 m, top 2.4 m, bottom 1.0×0.18 m, webs 0.20 m at 1:3.5, haunch 0.201×0.062 m, chamfers 0.15×0.07 m) gives A_single=1.0605 m², I_single=0.25166 m⁴; combined girder A=4.2421 m², I=1.00663 m⁴. Ec=34500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5), γ=26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1), w=110.294 kN/m, m=11.243 t/m (self-weight of main girders only).

Bearings: PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric (2 per girder end × 4 girders = 8 per line) on abutments 0/10 and piers 1-4, 7-9 → longitudinal free (Kh=0); plain laminated elastomeric (fixed) on piers 5 and 6 → longitudinal spring Kh=26250 kN/m. All bearings 300×350 mm, 4×8 mm layers → S=10.096, Kv=1.133×10⁷ kN/m, rotation free.

Live load: JTG D60-2015 Highway Class I, one-way, 3 design lanes → ξ=0.78, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=310 kN (all 25 m spans). Modal analysis gave f1=4.415 Hz, so impact factor μ=0.1767·ln(f1)−0.0157=0.2467.

Results: first vertical bending frequencies 4.415/4.536/4.884 Hz; max self-weight midspan moment 4985 kN·m (end spans); lane max positive moment 6410 kN·m and max negative moment −4601 kN·m. All L1/L2/L3 checks passed. No unresolved issues.
